title: Butter Chicken
summary: Random recipe which turned out alright, and is a fun one to do...
extendedSummary: Random recipe which turned out alright, and is a fun one to do occassionally. Honestly, I'm not super sold on it, as I've had waaaayyy better butter chicken at restaurants, but this is a place holder butter chicken recipe until I can figure out how Piquancy on Auburn Rd does their curry... so fucking good man
source: RecipeTin Eats... do not sue me for plagarism pls

items: 1/2 tsp chilli powder or cayenne pepper powder

method: Combine the Marinade ingredients with the chicken in a bowl. Cover and refrigerate overnight, or up to 24 hours (minimum 3 hrs).

Heat the ghee (butter or oil) over high heat in a large fry pan. Take the chicken out of the Marinade but do not wipe or shake off the marinade from the chicken (but don’t pour the Marinade left in the bowl into the fry pan).
Place chicken in the fry pan and cook for around 3 minutes, or until the chicken is white all over (it doesn’t really brown because of the Marinade).
